main_body: A tall two-door wardrobe. The top rows 1-7 form a lintel or cornice panel with a lighter band at row 5, and the doors fill rows 10-27 below it.
top_band: No real top surface. Rows 1-4 are mid-brown (L~127), the same family as the front. Row 5 is a 1-row lighter line (L157). Rows 6-7 return to the mid-brown. This is a cornice drawn face-on, not a horizontal surface.
evidence: The column scan shows no top band separated from the front by at least 25 L. Rows 1-4 (L127) differ from the front face (L124-130) by under 25 L, so they belong to the front. Only the single row 5 is lighter (L157), which is a 1px edge line. Rows 8-9 are a dark shadow line, and rows 10-27 are the doors, drawn flat and face-on with inset panels. This matches the red 'front elevation: top 1' and 'rim only' guide shapes, because nothing reads as a horizontal surface seen from above.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 10 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references. Its median of 9 colours per tile is under half the reference median (17-20). Its dark edge pixels are 100% neutral, which fits the black sticker-like outline, while the references are 1% and 33% neutral. The door panels and the upper panel are smooth, flat brown areas with little grain, and the only detail is a few dots on the upper panel. The ramp has about 4 brown steps (dark, mid, light, highlight), fewer than the references' 5-6. The piece looks thinner and flatter next to the stall and well.
